_comment: Image providers for tools/asset-gen. Shape deliberately mirrors
tools/campaign-gen/config.json so the two generators are read the same way.
Keys are NEVER stored here -- each provider names the env var it reads.
PRICING IS A LOCAL COPY AND IT GOES STALE. Figures are USD per image, by
quality and requested size, checked on the date below against the official
pages. The tool only ever calls them an estimate; the invoice is the truth.
Correct a number by editing it here -- nothing computes prices in code.

_comment: Settings for the sdapi providers above. The ControlNet model conditions a
generated albedo on an ALREADY AUTHORED height map (gen.py --height), so
paint lands in the grooves the mesh will actually have. Note the direction:
height is never estimated from the art -- estimation was measured useless on
this project's pixel work -- it is authored by tools/asset-gen/heightgen.py
and the picture is made to agree with it.
